newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pacific says market conditions better.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pacific says market conditions better.

text.p: Asia Pacific Resources International Holdings Ltd, Singapore-based pulp, paper and rayon fiber producer, said on Monday market conditions for its products have improved over the past few months.

In a statement included in its 1996 earnings report for the fiscal year ended December 31, the company said the price of bleached hardwood kraft pulp in Asia improved from a low of approximately US$390 per tonne in April to US$450 per tonne in May and June.
"Acceptance of the price increase has been satisfactory in all markets," it said.
Order flow and size for pulp remains steady in all markets, including China, it said. It added that in China, it has not seen indication of significant inventory buildup.
The price of rayon fiber is expected to remain stable at the current price level due to continued competitive pressure from cotton and polyester, it said.
